name: Chen Yinlin
source:
As a child bride, she was traded to the Tangxia village at a very young age. In an accident, the villagers who brought her to the village all died and she was cast away, considered a jinx. With the help from a kindhearted villager, Yufan Wu, she was able to survive. Now she is living alone.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/629960/A_summer_promise_to_forever/]Steam[/url]]
